title: The Minions and the golden banana.
lines: They are small and yellow, like yellow sweets.
Some have one eye, some have two.
They all wear big goggles and blue dungarees.
And they speak a very strange language.
And when they like something, they say: Banana!
Because do you know what Minions love most of all?
There are three Minions who are best friends.
Kevin is tall, with two eyes.
He has two eyes in two different colours.
He always has his teddy bear with him.
One morning Kevin, Stuart and Bob are in the kitchen.
Then Kevin sees something on the television.
There's an exhibition at the museum.
In the middle there's a glass case.
And inside it lies a banana made of gold.
They want to see the golden banana.
But they're so small that they can't reach the button.
Bob climbs onto Stuart's shoulders, and Stuart onto Kevin's shoulders.
People are walking around looking at paintings.
And inside lies the golden banana.
Bob presses his nose against the glass.
He gives the glass a little kiss.
But then an alarm goes off.
Hey, what are you doing there?
Through the big hall, under a bench, behind a statue.
Stuart trips over his own feet.
They hide in a big vase.
I saw three little yellow things.
Then he looks at the glass case.
The golden banana is still there.
He only sees a nose smudge and a little kiss on the glass.
Everyone wants to see the golden banana.
There's a market on the square.
A whole mountain of yellow bananas!
The fruit seller is an old man with a big moustache.
But they don't have any money.
They spin around and wiggle their bottoms.
The people at the market stop.
And they throw coins into Bob's hat.
After the song they have enough money.
They buy a big bunch of bananas.
At home they eat their bananas.
Kevin says something in Minion language.
It means: An ordinary banana is actually much tastier than a golden banana.
Because you can't eat a golden banana.
He gives a piece to Tim the teddy bear.
